newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Leningrad region to get $100 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Leningrad region to get $100 mln credit.

text.p: Russia's Leningrad region hopes to receive a $100 million syndicated loan from 25 European banks in September, an official said on Monday.
Deputy regional governor Sergei Susekov said the loan would run for four years at 9.5 percent annual.
He had said previously the credit would replace a Eurobond which the region had planned.
Leningrad region, under whose jurisdiction Russia's second city St Petersburg falls, will use the credit for various investment projects, mostly in the energy sector.
